title: Re-pin regenerated guidance and propagate the 320-minute budget

outcomes.statement: The reconciler accepts the reviewed 2026-09-05 generated guidance and deterministically converges every agent-facing readiness limit to 320 minutes without rewriting historical migration layers.
outcomes.demo: Run the focused reconciler suite and check mode from both prior-pinned and newly generated fixtures; both converge to the SHA-256-pinned current guidance, and all five mirrors say 320 minutes.

uncertainties.statement: Whether re-pinning should mutate the historical CHG-004 and CHG-022 artifacts or append a new migration layer.
uncertainties.resolution: Append CHG-042 as a new layer whose source artifacts are the prior reviewed outputs and whose desired artifacts are the reviewed 2026-09-05 states. Historical layers remain byte-for-byte immutable.
